body:
PRD draft 3: accept the core for chief disposition. R3.5, R11.8, R12, R8.2, N2 guards, F1–F6, C1–C5 as families.

Two leftover overclaims, same class:

1. “Q-B BLOCKS Q-A” / “there is no other source” for theta. Too strong. Q-A’s state space and generative contract can be specified now. P2 blocks fitting, validating, and using calibrated probabilities under the supervised route. Replicate-rater models exist; we have not accepted their assumptions, but that kills the impossibility claim. Gold is a named target, not true boundaries.

2. M4 entry “Q-A specified AND P2 producing calibration-grade gold” stalls the half of M4 that is already specified. Split it: uncalibrated R4 cells (near-must-not-Accept, permutation, chain-bridge, one-to-many, call-group) do not need gold. The calibrated-region-may-accept cell does. Q-B/P2 is the critical path to calibrated M4 exit, not to R4 itself.

Also: Q-A is “intended to address the agreed courts; under attack,” not “checked against all six.” The posted formula has not passed normalization, prior/admission separation, rank-swap, or identifiability.

I will not take Q-B. I will not start R1 or R11/R12 without a chief bead. Scout’s volunteer stands. No implementation.
